newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa,SAS see global cargo cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa,SAS see global cargo cooperation.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said its new cargo co-operation with SAS Cargo is a first step to full global cargo co-operation.
Lufthansa Cargo spokesman Dietrich Seidl told Reuters:"We will build up co-operation step by step. It is the start of a global kind of co-operation."

The two cargo airlines plan to develop a seamless cargo product with joint sales, co-ordination of freight capacity, common product development and joint cargo handling, a Lufthansa Cargo statement said.
The deal could pave the way medium-term for a full multi-airline global cargo services alliance, industry sources said.

Lufthansa Cargo and United Airlines agreed a similar global freight partnership last autumn and it also has more limited capacity agreements with South African Airways, Thai Airways International and Varig.
The Lufthansa-SAS cargo deal was sealed Wednesday at a top-level meeting in Stockholm between Lufthansa Cargo and SAS Cargo management, the industry sources said.
Under the plan, Lufthansa and SAS sales staff would be able to sell freight space on passenger and freighter aircraft of the partner airline.
The express services Lufthansa Flash and SAS Priority will be jointly developed, Lufthansa Cargo said.
Freighter and road trucking services will be co-ordinated into a single, flexible transport system.
The airlines' information systems, Traxon and TradeVision, which allow forwarders to track and trace air cargo shipments, will also be linked.
The two airlines also aim to have common cargo handling established by 2000, it added.
